name: Club 30+ New York
description: A traveling early-evening club night for people over 30, with DJs, disco balls and confetti, running 5 to 9 PM so guests are home early.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Club 30+ is a franchise that started in Europe and is touring North America. DJ names were not published.

Directory research 2026-10-04: The only official web presence found is the US promoter's ticket pages: club30plus.us (redirects to the Patchogue Universe ticket page) and the 'Club 30+ USA' Eventbrite organizer profile. No Facebook, Instagram or Spotify link could be verified (the ticket text mentions a Spotify playlist but gives no link; search-engine summaries suggesting handles like 'club30usa' could not be confirmed). This US 'Club 30+' does not appear to be the Irish/UK 'The 30+ Club' (the30plus.club, which sells through Ticket Tailor). Logo is the 200x200 profile image from the Eventbrite organizer page (small but above 120 px); the Universe profile image is only 50 px and the other images are text flyers, so no photos. A contact name and phone printed on one third-party listing (events.longisland.com) belong to an individual and were not recorded. The Patchogue dates (Oct 2-3, 2026) have now passed and no further Long Island dates were listed; the Universe host profile gives its base as 'East Patchogue'. Town left empty because it is a touring event.

logo.alt: Club 30+ logo: the words Club 30+ in white bubble letters on a bright blue circle

evidence.note: Eventbrite organizer profile 'Club 30+ USA' (organizer of 'Club 30+ : PATCHOGUE NY (Stereo Garden)', Sat Oct 3, 2026, 5-9 PM) lists its website as www.club30plus.us.

Universe ticket listing 'Club 30+ : (Patchogue)' hosted by 'Club 30+': Stereo Garden, 9 Railroad Ave, Patchogue; Oct 2 and Oct 3, 2026, 5 PM start; text says it sold out clubs across Europe and is on a North American tour, playing…
club30plus.us currently redirects straight to the Universe ticket page for the Patchogue event.

factsSource: Checked October 4, 2026. Sources: eventbrite.com, universe.com, club30plus.us.
